name: Cottonwood Partner Onboarding
description: Onboard Cottonwood as the third partner firm. Identity-and-allowlist only — no data pipeline. One initial user (user@cottonwood.com, role=user) gets access to a tailored subset of the portal: market overview, model portfolios, capital markets, positioning, attribution, factor tilts, valuations, correlations, macroeconomics, security scanner, trade submission. Excludes advisor intelligence, portfolio management, data refresh.
phase: Phase 0 — PRD authored 2026-04-29 by 1.0.0_SA_CTO under ADHC_COMPIL.003 §5 mandate. 4 TOs (+ 1 sub-TO for ONBOARDING.md drift backfill) ready for COO decomposition. Pods 0.7 (AE CloudOps — Terraform) + 0.4 (DT ClientPlatform — DDB seed + portal map). Single-day ship estimate; TO-1 + TO-2 parallelizable, TO-3 gates on TO-1, TO-4 gates on all three.
